messages:
Nadine: Quick sync  prepping the launch email for the Benchmark webinar + newsletter spotlight. Need: final subject/preheader A/B, a clean churn-risk segment, suppression checks, and send throttles. Can folks review by EOD?

Liam: Happy to take subject lines. Two variants: A) "Join our Benchmark webinar: real-world cost & latency wins" B) "How teams cut LLM inference cost by 3x  webinar". Preheaders: 1) "Live demo + customer case studies" 2) "Benchmarks, tips, and Q&A".

Priya: For the churn-risk cohort, propose: users with last_login between 30-90d, trial_started > 14d, and email_opens < 3. Quick SQL: 
```
SELECT id, email FROM users
WHERE last_login BETWEEN now()-90 AND now()-30
AND trial_start < now()-14
AND email_opens_last_30 < 3
AND unsubscribed = false
```
We should include a 7d suppression for recent marketing sends.

Marco: +1 on SQL. Also add domain-level suppression for bounce domains and shared suppression list `suppression_marketing_v2`. Ops: can you run a dedupe and preview count?

ops-bot: Campaign check queued: `benchmark-launch-2026-04`. Estimated recipients: 12,480 (pre-suppression). Dedupe and suppression pending. ETA for report: 2h.

Jess: Regarding send windows: we should timezone-split (US morning, EMEA mid-morning, APAC early evening local). If we do a single UTC pass, I'd push to 1500 UTC to catch US morning and EMEA late morning, but APAC will be late night. Ops: do we have ability to do timezone send?

ops-bot: Yes, timezone-based send supported. Suggest 3 passes: 14:00 UTC (US), 09:00 UTC (EMEA), 23:00 UTC (APAC local equivalent). Throttle recommendation: 6k/hr for first pass, 4k/hr afterwards to control ramping.

Nadine: Good. Liam  pick your preferred subject A/B by noon. Priya  can you add the suppression rule to the SQL (exclude suppression_marketing_v2) and drop sample CSV? Marco  once ops-bot posts counts please share the final list size. I'll update the campaign doc: https://docs.redwood.com/campaigns/benchmark-launch-email (draft).

Liam: Leaning B for marketing list, A for churn-risk to be less sales-y. I'll mark that in the doc.

Priya: Added suppression line to SQL and exported sample CSV to internal S3: s3://redwood-marketing/exports/benchmark-launch-sample.csv.

Marco: Received ops-bot report: Post-suppression recipients = 9,312. Unique by email = 9,295 (17 dups removed). Ops recommends throttling to 5k/hr first wave to keep deliverability healthy.

Nadine: Perfect. Last ask: subject line length cap 60 chars, preheader cap 100. Also please sanity-check the RSVP page URL UTMs: ?utm_campaign=benchmark-launch&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email . I'll queue a final review + send approval in the campaign doc. :rocket:
